diff --git a/importer.py b/importer.py
index 0cdb74a..21be05a 100644
--- a/importer.py
+++ b/importer.py
@@ -1,10 +1,23 @@
 """Load bank transactions into our budget format."""
 from datetime import datetime
 
+# Tried in order. Dash dates (old account) come first so they parse exactly as before.
+# Slash dates (new account) are day first: 03/04/2024 is 3 April 2024.
+DATE_FORMATS = ("%Y-%m-%d", "%d/%m/%Y")
+
 
 def parse_date(text):
-    """Turn the date column into a date. Handles 2024-03-15 style dates."""
-    return datetime.strptime(text.strip(), "%Y-%m-%d").date()
+    """Turn the date column into a date.
+
+    Handles 2024-03-15 style dates and day-first 15/03/2024 style dates.
+    """
+    text = text.strip()
+    for fmt in DATE_FORMATS:
+        try:
+            return datetime.strptime(text, fmt).date()
+        except ValueError:
+            continue
+    raise ValueError(f"Unrecognised date: {text!r}")
 
 
 def parse_amount(text):
diff --git a/tests/test_importer.py b/tests/test_importer.py
index 283e0d0..ac46f35 100644
--- a/tests/test_importer.py
+++ b/tests/test_importer.py
@@ -1,5 +1,7 @@
 from datetime import date
 
+import pytest
+
 import importer
 
 
@@ -7,6 +9,21 @@ def test_parse_dash_date():
     assert importer.parse_date(" 2024-03-15 ") == date(2024, 3, 15)
 
 
+def test_parse_slash_date_is_day_first():
+    assert importer.parse_date("03/04/2024") == date(2024, 4, 3)
+    assert importer.parse_date("15/03/2024") == date(2024, 3, 15)
+
+
+def test_parse_slash_date_strips_whitespace():
+    assert importer.parse_date(" 03/04/2024 ") == date(2024, 4, 3)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad", ["03/15/2024", "31/04/2024", "2024/03/15", ""])
+def test_parse_bad_date_raises(bad):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        importer.parse_date(bad)
+
+
 def test_parse_amount():
     assert importer.parse_amount("1,234.50") == 1234.5
     assert importer.parse_amount("20.00-") == -20.0
@@ -17,3 +34,10 @@ def test_parse_row():
     assert importer.parse_row(row) == {
         "date": date(2024, 1, 2), "description": "Rent", "amount": -950.0,
     }
+
+
+def test_parse_row_slash_date():
+    row = {"Date": "03/04/2024", "Description": " Rent ", "Amount": "950.00-"}
+    assert importer.parse_row(row) == {
+        "date": date(2024, 4, 3), "description": "Rent", "amount": -950.0,
+    }
